title: Create the ReadTheDocs project for the Python implementation and verify the build
description:
The Python docs (python/docs) and .readthedocs.yaml at the repo root are ready, but no nrdl project exists on ReadTheDocs: the API token in ~/.read-the-docs-api-key only has access to degasolv, lighthouse-scheduler, pask, and pylighthouse, and POST /api/v3/projects/nrdl/versions/latest/builds/ returns 'No Project matches the given query'.

To finish: create a project on readthedocs.org that imports github.com/djha-skin/nrdl (or repoint the API key to an account with such a project). RTD will pick up .readthedocs.yaml and build python/docs automatically on push; alternatively trigger with: source ~/.read-the-docs-api-key && curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Token ${READTHEDOCS_API_KEY}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' https://readthedocs.org/api/v3/projects/nrdl/versions/latest/builds/

The python-0.1.0 tag and PyPI publish are already done.
close_reason: Project created via POST /api/v3/projects/ (id 1189715, slug nrdl, repo github.com/djha-skin/nrdl). Build 34126032 (latest, commit 6a876d8) succeeded; docs live at https://nrdl.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ (title 'NRDL for Python - nrdl 0.1.0 documentation'). The auto-created 'stable' version points at the old 0.7.0 tag (no docs config) and cannot build; deactivated it and set default_version to latest. Note: RTD GitHub webhook for auto-builds on push may need to be added in the dashboard (Integrations) since the project was imported via API.
